title: Every morning it's like Easter and you have to go find the vacuum
text: Every morning it's like Easter and you have to go find the vacuum. My husband bought this for me, while I was out of town. Although it does vacuum somewhat well, it gets lost, or stuck and NEVER makes it home. Every morning it's like Easter and you have to go find the vacuum. Sometimes it just gives up in the middle of the room. It starts off by moving it's home, so we used some velcro tape to keep it in place. But I wouldn't buy again for sure.
